listen_address.description: IP address to bind the HTTP server to (e.g., 127.0.0.1 for localhost only, or 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

listen_port.description: TCP port for the HTTP server (must be between 1 and 65535).

storage_dir.description: Directory where captured packets and metadata will be stored on disk.

max_sessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent capture sessions allowed.

max_packet_bytes.description: Maximum number of bytes to capture per packet. Set to 0 for unlimited (full packet capture).

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to capture traffic on.

log_packets.description: Whether to write raw captured packets to log files.

log_rotate_size.description: Size (in MB) at which packet logs are rotated.

log_rotate_count.description: Number of old log files to retain after rotation.

exclude_ips.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR subnets to exclude from capture (e.g., internal loopback ranges).

items.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address or CIDR subnet.

filter_bpf.description: Berkeley Packet Filter (BPF) expression to selectively capture traffic (e.g., 'tcp port 80'). Empty means capture all.

tcp_hosts.description: List of TCP services to monitor for connectivity (not part of packet capture, but for active health checks).

hostname.description: Hostname or IP address of the TCP service.

tls_api.description: Enable TLS (HTTPS) for the management API endpoint.

tls_cert.description: Path to the TLS certificate file for the management API.

tls_key.description: Path to the TLS private key file for the management API.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to stdout and logs.

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use when logging to the system journal (e.g., daemon, local0).

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file used to track the main process.
